subject.title: Clarify status of optional bird transport

question: How should Birdclaw publicly document `bird` now that a maintainer has said the tool is private while current docs still publish the deprecated npm and unavailable GitHub install path?
rationale: The source still supports `bird` and recent code improved bird-backed flows, but only a maintainer can choose whether docs should demote, preserve as private/advanced, or restore public `bird` distribution.

options.title: Document xurl as the public path
options.body: Update docs so new users use `xurl`, and describe `bird` as private or existing-user-only unless they already have a working install path.

options.title: Restore public bird distribution
options.body: Republish or unhide a supported `bird` package/repository, then keep Birdclaw docs recommending both transports with working setup links.

options.title: Remove bird setup docs for now
options.body: Delete public `bird` install instructions while leaving current code paths and config overrides for users who already have the binary.

recommendation.title: Document xurl as the public path
recommendation.body: Update docs so new users use `xurl`, and describe `bird` as private or existing-user-only unless they already have a working install path.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision depends on the external `bird` package/repository status and the desired public transport recommendation for Birdclaw.
